text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Overlord of Raging Waves, your 
power has undeniably grown. However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't seem to hold a candle to the 
'End-of-Century Overlord' who woke from an 
eternal slumber and nearly shattered the 
frozen earth!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Opera O-san is so strong...

T.M. Opera O was victorious over Meisho 
Doto.

Their showdown seems to have reached a 
conclusion for now, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what will you do, Doto? With 
this curtain call, it's about time we 
define what we are to each other, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I ask thee, Meisho Doto! Just what manner 
of being art thou!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Will you become my lifelong nemesis, to 
perform in a battle of gods—Ragnarok—of 
which none know the end, or not!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uuu, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san's... lifelong rival...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A B S O L U T E L Y N O T ! ! ! ! !

Words filled with so many heartfelt 
emotions echoed throughout autumn at 
Fuchu.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Running today... made me realize. As I 
thought, Opera O-san isn't my enemy at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She's my idol, my goal, and the person 
I've been chasing after all this timeeee!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Because Opera O-san was there, I was able 
to become this strong... And I can keep 
getting stronger from now on.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's not about being enemies, but 
something much warmer. It's not like I 
want us to hurt each other.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I want to be your "rival"! 
Not an enemy, but your "lifelong rival"!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
To be rivals who run together forever, 
trading wins and losses!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Because I think... that brings the 
greatest happiness.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Happiest of all...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see... Doto... So that is the answer 
you've found.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Very well. In that case—

T.M. Opera O took Meisho Doto in front of 
the grandstand—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hear me, fans filling this arena!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, this Meisho Doto is the 
rival who will continue running closest to 
me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over this fierce yet 
beautiful bond we share as we battle, our 
hearts connected as one.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And I promise you! Now that I've found a 
worthy rival and gained even more 
momentum—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The year-end Arima Kinen! She will show 
everyone she can truly surpass the Golden 
Generation!!
(UOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Is this alright? My dear friend, Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Um... Opera O-san! Good luck in 
the Arima Kinen~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I'll do my best. As the king of our 
generation, and for Doto and Ayabe-san's 
sakes, too."

And so, their story reached a happy 
ending, competing against each other while 
still holding hands.

Yet the true decisive battle is still to 
come. At the Arima Kinen, the strongest 
generation awaits the supreme king.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, let's go. To the final grand 
stage.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With Doto not running, I am likely the 
only one from our generation who can 
battle the heroes of the past era. 
However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing to fear. As long as you 
remain by my side, that is.

We exchange a firm, determined glance. 
T.M. Opera O turns toward the packed 
grandstand, and—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My friends, I am T.M. Opera O! And today, 
by uniting with my fellow generation—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Together, they all became the 'T.M. Opera 
O Party'!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As you all know, the Umamusume competing 
in the Arima Kinen are decided by fan 
vote.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For me to advance in the top spot, I 
require everyone's support. And 
therefore——!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone gathered here today! Please cast 
your pure and honest vote for the TM Opera 
Party! I beg of you, give me your 
vooooote!"

TM Opera O begged for votes. Carried away 
by the momentum, she somehow started 
speaking in polite keigo...
